title: The Hartree-Fock Approximation
author: Daniel Fischer
---

tbd


```{mermaid}
%%| fig-align: center
%%| fig-alt: Flowchart describing the Hartree-Fock method.
flowchart TD
    Start["Trial potential φ⁽⁰⁾(x)"] --> SolveSchrodinger["Solve SE and get φᵢ⁽⁰⁾, Eᵢ⁽⁰⁾<br/>[-ℏ²/2m ∇ᵢ² + φ⁽⁰⁾(xᵢ)] ψᵢ⁽⁰⁾ = Eᵢ⁽⁰⁾ψᵢ⁽⁰⁾"]
    
    SolveSchrodinger --> OccupyOrbitals["Occupy orbitals φᵢ⁽⁰⁾ with energy Eᵢ⁽⁰⁾<br/>with all N electrons obeying Pauli exclusion principle"]
    
    OccupyOrbitals --> CalcNewPotential["Calculate new average potential φᵢ⁽¹⁾<br/>for i = 1, ..., N<br/>φᵢ⁽¹⁾ = -e/4πε₀ ∫[Σⱼ≠ᵢ (1/|xᵢ - xⱼ|) |ψⱼ⁽⁰⁾(xⱼ)|²dxⱼ]"]
    
    CalcNewPotential --> PutInSE["Put in SE and calculate<br/>φᵢ⁽¹⁾, Eᵢ⁽¹⁾"]
    
    PutInSE --> CheckConvergence["Check for convergence:<br/>Compare φᵢ⁽ⁿ⁾, Eᵢ⁽ⁿ⁾ with φᵢ⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾, Eᵢ⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾"]
    
    CheckConvergence --> Decision{"Within<br/>tolerance?"}
    
    Decision -->|NO| OccupyOrbitals
    Decision -->|YES| Result["Result"]
    
    style Start fill:#e1f5ff
    style Result fill:#d4edda
    style Decision fill:#fff3cd
```
